name: Grand Regent Reina
title: Grand Regent Reina
heroSub: Wisteria Violet Cubic Zirconia, sister of Nightshade Violet Diamond and Grand Regent Antton, and the only gem in the Gempire who refuses to walk.
facts: Same planet as Nightshade Violet Diamond
equipment: Endless Glass of Highly Volatile Green Liquid Energy
personality: Reina is eccentric, aggressively confident, and theatrical to a fault. She lives for the spotlight, carrying herself with an unshakeable belief that she is the most entertaining person in any room. She is incredibly loud and expressive, yet she communicates often, rather intentionally, as if she is being very selective with her wording choice. She has a very dry, sarcastic sense of humor and absolutely zero patience for boring, repetitive conversations. When she gets bored, she simply tunes people out to play games on her visor.

Despite her dramatic and self-absorbed exterior, Reina is remarkably sharp-witted and observant. She doesn't easily lose her temper; instead, she handles stressful situations very smugly, playfully, and calmly, which typically infuriates the opposing party. She is fiercely independent and highly protective, showing a lot of patience only to those she genuinely cares about. Which is to say that to everyone else, she is a puzzle who refuses to take anything seriously.
likes: Drinking Highly Volatile Green Liquid Energy from fancy glasses
dislikes: Slow internet and data transmission speeds
Standing on her own feet (walking is for peasants)
Quiet rooms that don't have background music
Anyone claiming they are cooler than her
fear: Nightshade getting shattered, or worse: Nightshade being forced to give a 3-hour public speech without her there to rescue him.

abilities.name: Sleep Manipulation
abilities.label: Sub-Domain: Sleep · Advanced
desc: Reina can pull a mind down into true sleep and walk right into its dreams. Once she's inside, she can read the dream, turn it into a nightmare, or make the sleeper get up and move without ever waking them. The sleeper thinks every step was their own idea. To everyone watching, it just looks like Reina is lounging on her couch, barely paying attention.
Weakness: Anything that can't sleep, like a Gem Machine, ignores this power. Most of her spells need a target who is already Asleep, so when Pacify fails, she has very little to work with.

passives.name: Dream Reader
passives.text: Whenever an enemy falls Asleep, Reina gets a look at their dream and learns their stats and spells, as if she had CHECKed them.

passives.name: Blind Spot Sense
passives.text: Reina always knows where nobody is looking. In any room, crowd, or battlefield, she can tell exactly where she could be without being seen. Her first attack from Behind or from hiding has advantage. While she's in the party, darkness doesn't slow the Star Gauge.

spells.name: Pacify
spells.text: Reina reaches into one target's mind and drags it down into true sleep. The target resists with INT. If they fail, they fall Asleep for 2 turns and can't act or dodge. Any damage wakes them up early.

spells.name: Rude Awakening
spells.text: Requires a target who is Asleep. Reina yanks them out of their dream from the inside. They wake up and take 3d6 damage.

spells.name: Power Nap
spells.text: Reina puts one ally into a short, perfect nap. They're Asleep until their next turn and can't act or dodge. When they wake up, they heal 1/4 of their max HP. If they take damage first, they wake up early and don't heal.

spells.name: Bad Dream
spells.text: Requires a target who is Asleep. Reina turns their dream into a nightmare they won't shake off. After they wake up, they're Frightened for 2 turns, and their attacks are made with disadvantage.

spells.name: Ruler of the Dreaming
spells.text: Reina takes over the dreams of up to 3 Asleep targets. They get up and sleepwalk over to her side, sure that fighting for her was their own choice. While they sleepwalk, their stats and damage are halved. A sleepwalker wakes up and stops fighting for her when they drop below 35% HP, get poofed, or are hit by an ability that wakes sleepers.

abilities.name: Engineering
abilities.label: SKILL · Advanced
desc: Engineering is tinkering and experimenting with gem tech, using whatever tech is around in the moment. Outside of battle, Reina uses it to craft tools, supplies, and a pile of random machines nobody asked for.
Weakness: Engineering is slow and leaves Reina open to attack unless she's somewhere safe, like a closed space or the middle of her party. Anything she builds can also malfunction.

spells.name: Throw
spells.text: Reina throws a hunk of machinery at one target. It deals 1d5 damage.

spells.name: Hotwire
spells.text: Reina patches up one Gem Machine or item for 1d6, or jams one enemy machine so its next attack has disadvantage.

spells.name: Reinforce
spells.text: Reina bolts extra plating onto one ally. They get +2 DEF for 2 turns.

spells.name: Booby Trap
spells.text: Reina sets a trap where she is. The next enemy who moves Near her resists with SPD, or they're Stuck for 1 turn.

spells.name: Scrap Bomb
spells.text: Reina throws a homemade explosive. Every enemy who is Near takes 2d6 damage and resists with SPD. Those who pass take half.

appearance: Reina lounges on a throne of jagged violet crystal with her legs crossed, smiling like she already knows how the meeting ends. Her lavender hair is curled up into a bun and topped with a small spiked crown set with a gold star. A black visor wraps across her eyes.

She wears a tall white collar that rises up behind her head, a buttoned purple vest with a big glossy bow at the neck, and white puffed sleeves with ruffled cuffs under long purple gloves. Her skirt comes in layers: a purple overskirt, white ruffles, and a pleated underskirt in pale blue and white checks.

Her legs fade into dark stockings, and her heels look like they're made of cracked violet crystal that sheds little shards as she moves. In one hand, as always, she holds a glass of glowing green Highly Volatile Green Liquid Energy.
